report.summary: The impact between car-0 and car-1 was at t = 4.8 s. From t = 3.6 to 4.6 s, car-0 was at 52.8 km/h (90% interval 50.6 to 55.3) and car-1 was at 30.4 km/h (90% interval 28.9 to 31.9). The claim by s1 about the speed of the white car was not consistent with the footage, while the claim by s2 about the speed of the blue car was consistent with the footage. The claim by s2 that the white car did not brake was consistent with the footage, and no sustained braking was detected before impact. The claim by s1 that the light was green cannot be checked from the footage.
